articles.headline: Programmatic spend surges across SEA markets
articles.summary: Digital ad investment continues to climb with new data-driven strategies across Southeast Asia.
talkingPoints: Performance marketing in SEA is increasingly driven by first-party data.
Programmatic efficiency is improving rapidly across the region.

articles.headline: Retail media networks gain momentum in APAC
articles.summary: Retailers across Asia Pacific are launching ad networks to monetise their audiences.
talkingPoints: Retail media lets brands reach consumers closest to the point of purchase.
Closed-loop measurement connects ad spend directly to sales.

articles.headline: Agency account moves signal shifting brand priorities
articles.summary: Several major advertisers have consolidated their media buying with new agency partners.
talkingPoints: Account moves signal brands are seeking more integrated, data-driven partners.
New agency relationships often coincide with a fresh look at digital channel mix.
